theorems.statement: ∀ m ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ ℓ → ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))) (m + 1), Q.mass + Q.boundary.mass < ∞ → Q.support ⊆ ⋃ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ), latticeFace 1 F → (∀ (F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ)) (y : Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (r : ℝ), ball y r ∩ (⋃ G : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ), latticeFace 1 G) ⊆ latticeFace 1 F → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball y r → (∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ)) (m + 1)) x (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (F.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) = 0) → Q ω = 0) → ∃ (β : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1 + ℓ) → ℝ) (P S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1 + ℓ))) (m + 1)), IsLatticeChain 1 β P ∧ (∀ ω, Q ω - P ω = S ω) ∧ P.mass ≤ C * Q.mass ∧ P.boundary.mass ≤ C * Q.boundary.mass ∧ S.mass ≤ C * Q.boundary.mass ∧ P.support ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) Q.support ∧ P.boundary.support ∪ S.support ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) Q.boundary.support ∧ (IsIntegerMultiplicity Q → (∀ F, ∃ k : ℤ, β F = k) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity P)
